name: postcloak
description: Chrome extension that opens an x.com post in an Incognito window.

scripts.check: node --check post-url.js && node --check background.js && node --check content.js && node -e "['manifest.json','_locales/en/messages.json','_locales/ja/messages.json','package.json'].forEach(f => JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(f, 'utf8')))"
